title: flows.drafts.resolve payload
description: A person answered a proposal: it became an automation, or it was discarded. There is no `outcome` that makes a draft run — accepting one is `POST /api/hub/flows` from the editor, paused and ungranted, and this only records that it happened.

flow_id.description: The automation it turned into, when the outcome is `used`; the empty string when it was discarded. Required so the column never has to accept a NULL the caller did not mean.
